Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About Brow & Lash Serum Is this suitable for all skin types? Since every skin type is different, we recommend doing a patch test before incorporating it in your routine. Will it irritate my eyes? Be Bodywise Brow & Lash Growth Serum is made with 100% eye-safe ingredients; we recommend applying this with closed eyes, on the outside of the lash line, and on the brows. Can I apply makeup after applying this? We would recommend to wait till the serum absorbs into your skin, once done, you can apply makeup. How long till I see visible results? We recommend using this regularly for 3 months to see visible results.
